column2: Power blocs, treaties and the console command reference.
Open the power bloc panel: members, cohesion, identity, map mode.
Open the treaty window: exchange provinces or populations with another country.
Found a bloc led by you, or leave the bloc you are in (the most prestigious member takes over).
Leader only: change the bloc identity (Military, Trade, Empire, Religious). Each has its own monthly effects.
Leader only: dissolve your bloc. Every member leaves.
Colour the political map by bloc (countries outside blocs turn grey).
Invite this country into your bloc (the AI decides, with yesmen it accepts). Without a bloc, this founds one first.
Add this province to the treaty: yours are offered, theirs are asked for. Click again to remove it.
While on, every province you click on the map is added to (or removed from) the treaty.
Ask for every province of theirs where your primary culture is the majority.
Offer every province of yours where their primary culture is the majority.
Send the province exchange. A refusal costs 10 relations.
Which pops move in the population swap (click to cycle).
Each side receives its own people living in the other country. A refusal costs 5 relations.
